name: Nakadashi AV Satsuei Takuran Otoko ni Shikyuu o Akewatasu Hitozuma Bengoshi ~Anata no Kodomo wa Oroshimashita~
original_name: 膣内射精AV撮影 托卵男に子宮を明け渡す人妻弁護士 ～あなたの子供は堕ろしました～
source:
Five years after marrying his wife Aya, he found out they were expecting a long-awaited child and was at the peak of happiness.

I had bought a new house, work was busy but going well, and everything was going smoothly.

One day, I received some video data from an acquaintance.

The video showed an unbelievable image of his beloved wife. Is the actress in the mosaic really his wife, and is the child she is carrying really his?

Can you forgive your wife for betraying you?

[MTL Translated from [url=http://www.phantomsoft.info/04_bengo/index.html]Official site[/url]]
translation:
与妻子彩结婚五年后，他得知两人终于怀上期待已久的孩子，幸福达到顶点。他买了一所新房，工作虽然繁忙却进展顺利，一切都在按计划进行。

某天，他从熟人那里收到一段视频数据。

视频展示了心爱妻子令人难以置信的一面。马赛克中的女演员真的是他的妻子吗？她腹中的孩子真的是自己的吗？

你能原谅背叛你的妻子吗？

[原简介经机器翻译译自[url=http://www.phantomsoft.info/04_bengo/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
